description: Replace the CA host's own certificate with one generated offline by `puppetserver ca generate --ca-client`, which carries the pp_cli_auth extension the CA CLI needs. Run while OpenVox Server is stopped. Backs up the files it removes.

dns_alt_names.description: Subject alternative names to put on the new certificate. The old certificate's names are not carried over automatically.

force.description: Proceed even if puppetserver appears to be running.
